Task 2 · 城市住房 高层住宅是否是最佳方案
0% · 0 / 2 完成

围绕原题中的“best way”作答。

待改写句（自编）：Tall buildings contain more homes, so they are the best solution everywhere and will make housing affordable.

The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

将上面的句子改写为 35–50 个英文词。保留高层住宅的一项优势，但不给出题干未能支持的必然结果。

作答 1
暂时不会

写 80–110 个英文词：在土地紧张的城市里，将高层建设与“改造现有空置建筑”比较。选择一个判断标准，形成有条件的明确立场。

作答 2
暂时不会
答案
再练一次

However, additional supply does not automatically make housing affordable, and high-rise construction may not be the best option in every neighbourhood.2. 示例：Where suitable vacant buildings already exist, converting them into homes may provide accommodation sooner than constructing new towers. On a short-term delivery criterion, conversion could therefore be the better option, provided the buildings are safe and reasonably inexpensive to adapt. However, the supply of suitable vacant property is limited, and conversion cannot be assumed to meet all future demand. I would support high-rise development where land is scarce and existing buildings cannot supply enough homes, rather than treating it as the best response to every housing shortage.再练一次写 35–50 个英文词的结论。明确同意程度，并保留“新增住房数量”和“住房可负担性”的区别。作答暂时不会答案示例：I therefore agree that high-rise construction can be an important response to urban housing shortages, but not that it is always the best one.
